## Data Frame

```{r}

df <- raw %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1, PC2, Data.sources, Reference, Long, Lat)) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

# Adjusting data set so that all the species used have values for forelimb length, hindlimb length, total limb length, and head length

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(hd_l),
    !is.na(fll),
    !is.na(hll),
    !is.na(tll)
  )

summary(df[,c(
  "hd_l",
  "fll",
  "hll",
  "tll",
  "bd_wmean"
)])

#print(names(df))

#summary(df)

```

## Transform Data

Discrete Vs. Continuous

```{r}
# DISCRETE 
dat_disc <- df[,4, drop = FALSE]
rownames(dat_disc) <- df$species
dat_disc <- as.matrix(dat_disc)

colnames(df)
head(df)

#CONTINUOUS
dat_cont <- df[, -(1:4), drop = FALSE]
rownames(dat_cont) <- df$species
dat_cont <- as.matrix(dat_cont)

```

## PLOT GENERA

```{r}
phy <- tdat_disc$phy

#pdf(
# "C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/GeneraPhylogeny.pdf",
 #width = 10,
 # height = 12
#)

# define genera (from each focal group)
focal_clades <- list(
  "Anomalopus" = c(
    "Anomalopus", "Calyptotis", "Coeranoscincus",
    "Coggeria", "Ophioscincus", "Concinnia",
    "Nangura", "Silvascincus"
  ),
  "Glaphyromorphus" = c("Glaphyromorphus", "Eulamprus"),
  "Hemiergis" = c("Hemiergis", "Eremiascincus"),
  "Lerista" = c("Lerista", "Ctenotus")
)

# extract genus (that is the name for each genus)
genus <- sub("_.*", "", phy$tip.label)

# getting the node for each focal group
nodes <- sapply(focal_clades, function(genera) {
  tips <- phy$tip.label[genus %in% genera]
  if (length(tips) > 1) getMRCA(phy, tips) else NA
})

box_cols <- c(
  "Anomalopus" = "violet",
  "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
  "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
  "Lerista" = "maroon"
)

# plot tree
plot(
  phy, show.tip.label = TRUE,
  main = "Sphenomorphinae Phylogeny",
  cex = 0.5
)

par(xpd = NA)

legend(
  "bottom",
  inset = c(0, 0.-0.15),
  legend = names(box_cols),
  pch = 21,
  pt.bg = box_cols,
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.9
)


# opaque outline
for (group in names(nodes)) {
  if (!is.na(nodes[group])) {
    box <- cladebox(
      node = nodes[group],
      col = adjustcolor(box_cols[group], alpha.f = 0.15)
    )
    
    polygon(
      box$x, box$y,
      col = NA,
      border = box_cols[group],
      lwd = 1.5
    )
  }
}

#dev.off()
```
## POLYMORPHOSPACE With Raw Limb Length

```{r}
graphics.off()

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/Polymorphospace.pdf",
# width = 10,
 # height = 12
#)

tree <- tdat_disc$phy

focal_genera <- list(
  "Anomalopus" = c(
    "Anomalopus", "Calyptotis", "Coeranoscincus",
    "Coggeria", "Ophioscincus", "Concinnia",
    "Nangura", "Silvascincus"
  ),
  "Glaphyromorphus" = c("Glaphyromorphus", "Eulamprus"),
  "Hemiergis" = c("Hemiergis", "Eremiascincus"),
  "Lerista" = c("Lerista", "Ctenotus")
)

box_cols <- c(
  "Anomalopus" = "violet",
  "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
  "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
  "Lerista" = "maroon"
)

# Assigning focal groups
genus <- sub("_.*$", "", df$species)
df$focal_group <- NA_character_

for (grp in names(focal_genera)) {
  df$focal_group[genus %in% focal_genera[[grp]]] <- grp # groups based on genus names
}

# Raw limb length (not accounting for head length)

limb_traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

limb_labels <- c(
  fll = "Front limb length",
  hll = "Hind limb length",
  tll = "Total limb length"
)


# Reset plotting device and layout
layout(matrix(c(1, 2, 3,
                4, 4, 4),
              nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
       heights = c(4, 1))

par(mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))


for (trait in limb_traits) {
  
  plot_df <- df[
    complete.cases(df[, c("species", "bd_wmean", "focal_group", trait)]) &
      df$species %in% tree$tip.label,
  ]
  
  X <- as.matrix(plot_df[, c("bd_wmean", trait)])
  rownames(X) <- plot_df$species
  colnames(X) <- c("Soil bulk density", limb_labels[trait])
  
  td <- geiger::treedata(
    phy = tree,
    data = X,
    sort = TRUE,
    warnings = TRUE
  )
  
  X_matched <- td$data[td$phy$tip.label, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Matching focal groups with tree tip
  matched_rows <- match(td$phy$tip.label, plot_df$species)
  matched_groups <- plot_df$focal_group[matched_rows]
  point_cols <- unname(box_cols[matched_groups])
  
  # Creating morphospace
  phytools::phylomorphospace(
    tree = td$phy,
    X = X_matched,
    label = "off",
    xlab = "Soil bulk density",
    ylab = limb_labels[trait],
    node.size = c(0, 0),
    pch = NA,
    col = "grey40",
    cex = 0
  )
  
  # Creating terminal nodes
  points(
    X_matched[, 1],
    X_matched[, 2],
    pch = 21,
    bg = point_cols,
    col = "black",
    cex = 1.1
  )
  
  title(main = paste("Soil density vs.", limb_labels[trait]))
}

# Adding legend
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))

plot.new()

legend(
  "center",
  legend = c("Focal Group", names(box_cols)),
  pch = c(NA, rep(21, length(box_cols))),
  pt.bg = c(NA, box_cols),
  col = c(NA, rep("black", length(box_cols))),
  horiz = TRUE,
  bty = "n",
  pt.cex = 2,
  x.intersp = 1.2,
  inset = c(-0.1, -0.15),
  cex = 1.4
)

#dev.off()
```

## REGRESSION PGLs
Using had length as covariate to account for the relationship of body size to limb length

``` {r}

#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/RegressionPGL.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

plots <- list()
model_results <- data.frame() # creating empty data frame 

for(i in seq_along(traits)) { # created a loop to analyze fll, hll, and tll

  trait <- traits[i]

  # Refining data set
  plot_dat <- df[, c( # created a smaller data set based on df to only include prescribed variables
    "species",
    "focal_group",
    "bd_wmean",
    "hd_l",
    trait
  )]

  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat) # omits data when there is no value 

  # Match species to tree and removes species that are not present on the tree
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    plot_dat$species %in% tdat_disc$phy$tip.label,
  ]

  phy_sub <- ape::keep.tip(
    tdat_disc$phy,
    plot_dat$species
  )

  # Arrange data so that it is the same order as the tree
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    match(phy_sub$tip.label, plot_dat$species),
  ]

  rownames(plot_dat) <- plot_dat$species

  # Fiting to a linear model
  mod_lin <- phylolm(
    as.formula(
      paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean + hd_l") # "trait" refers to whichever trait is being analyzed either fll, hll, or tll
    ),
    data = plot_dat,
    phy = phy_sub,
    model = "lambda"
  )

  # Fitting to a quadratic model
  mod_quad <- phylolm(
    as.formula(
      paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean + I(bd_wmean^2) + hd_l")
    ),
    data = plot_dat,
    phy = phy_sub,
    model = "lambda"
  )

  # Comparing linear and quadratic models
  aic_lin <- AIC(mod_lin)
  aic_quad <- AIC(mod_quad)

  delta_aic <- aic_lin - aic_quad

  quad_coef <- summary(mod_quad)$coefficients

  model_results <- rbind(
    model_results,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Linear_AIC = aic_lin,
      Quadratic_AIC = aic_quad,
      Delta_AIC = delta_aic,
      Quad_Beta =
        quad_coef["I(bd_wmean^2)", "Estimate"],
      Quad_P =
        quad_coef["I(bd_wmean^2)", "p.value"]
    )
  )

  # Creating predictions
  pred <- data.frame(
    bd_wmean = seq(
      min(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
      max(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
      length.out = 200
    ),
    hd_l = mean(plot_dat$hd_l)
  )

  pred$linear_fit <- predict( # prediction for linear fit
    mod_lin,
    newdata = pred
  )

  pred$quad_fit <- predict( # prediction for quadratic fit
    mod_quad,
    newdata = pred
  )

  # Plot data and regression lines using ggplot2
  plots[[i]] <- ggplot(
    plot_dat,
    aes(
      x = bd_wmean,
      y = .data[[trait]],
      color = focal_group
    )
  ) +

    geom_point(size = 3) +

    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = linear_fit
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "gray",
      linewidth = 1,
      linetype = "dashed" # linear regression line is gray and dashed
    ) +

    geom_line(
      data = pred,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = quad_fit
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 1 # quadratic regression line is black and solid
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Anomalopus" = "violet",
        "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
        "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
        "Lerista" = "maroon"
      ),
      name = "Focal Group"
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      x = "Soil bulk density",
      y = c(
        fll = "Forelimb length",
        hll = "Hindlimb length",
        tll = "Total limb length"
      )[trait],
      subtitle = paste(
        "Delta AIC =",
        round(delta_aic, 2)
      )
    )
}

# Display AIC comparison table
print(model_results)

# Display all three plots on one page
(plots[[1]] | plots[[2]] | plots[[3]]) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

#dev.off()
```

## REGRESSION PGL ANALYSIS
Head length as covariate

```{r}

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

results <- data.frame() # empty data frame for results

for(trait in traits) { 

  # Refining data set
  plot_dat <- df[, c( # created a smaller data set based on df to only include prescribed variables
    "species",
    "focal_group",
    "bd_wmean",
    "hd_l",
    trait
  )]

  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat) # omits data when there is no value 

  # Match species to tree and removes species that are not present on the tree
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    plot_dat$species %in% tdat_disc$phy$tip.label,
  ]

  phy_sub <- ape::keep.tip(
    tdat_disc$phy,
    plot_dat$species
  )

   # Arrange data so that it is the same order as the tree
  plot_dat <- plot_dat[
    match(phy_sub$tip.label, plot_dat$species),
  ]

  rownames(plot_dat) <- plot_dat$species

  # Fit PGLS model
  mod <- phylolm(
    as.formula(
      paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean + hd_l") # "trait" refers to whichever trait is being analyzed either fll, hll, or tll
    ),
    data = plot_dat,
    phy = phy_sub,
    model = "lambda" # using lambda model
  )

  # Finding coefficients
  coef_tab <- summary(mod)$coefficients

  beta <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Estimate"] # beta
  se <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "StdErr"] # standard error
  p_value <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "p.value"] # p value

  # Finding R-squared: how much of observed is accounted for by predictors
  model_summary <- summary(mod)

  r2 <- model_summary$r.squared
  adj_r2 <- model_summary$adj.r.squared # adjusted for predictors

  # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
  df_res <- nrow(plot_dat) - length(coef(mod))
  tcrit <- qt(0.975, df_res)

  lower95 <- beta - tcrit * se
  upper95 <- beta + tcrit * se

  # Organize results
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      Trait = trait,
      Beta = beta,
      SE = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      R2 = r2,
      Adjusted_R2 = adj_r2,
      Lower95CI = lower95,
      Upper95CI = upper95
    )
  )
}

print(results)

```

## PGLs FOR EACH FOCAL GROUP
Head length as covariate
We ran this just to see if any significant patterns jumped out that would be worth investigating further. None did.

```{r}
#pdf(
 #"C:/Users/maela/OneDrive/Documents/Files/3M Course/Assignment Stuff/FocalGroupBreakdownPGL.pdf",
 #width = 10,
  #height = 12
#)

traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")
groups <- unique(na.omit(df$focal_group)) # creating object for each focal group; omits data when there is no value

plots <- list()
counter <- 1

for(trait in traits) { # loop for each trait

  for(grp in groups) { # loop for each focal group

    # Refining data set; filters species by focal group
    plot_dat <- df[
      df$focal_group == grp,
      c(
        "species",
        "focal_group",
        "bd_wmean",
        "hd_l", 
        trait
      )
    ]

    plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)
    
    # Skip groups with fewer than five observations
    if(nrow(plot_dat) < 5) next # was causing problems

    # Match species to tree and removes species that are not present on the tree
    plot_dat <- plot_dat[
      plot_dat$species %in% tdat_disc$phy$tip.label,
    ]

    # Pruning tree
    phy_sub <- ape::keep.tip(
      tdat_disc$phy,
      plot_dat$species
    )

    # Arrange data so that it is the same order as the tree
    plot_dat <- plot_dat[
      match(phy_sub$tip.label, plot_dat$species),
    ]

    rownames(plot_dat) <- plot_dat$species

    # Fit PGLS model
    mod <- phylolm(
      as.formula(
        paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean + hd_l") # "trait" refers to whichever trait is being analyzed either fll, hll, or tll
      ),
      data = plot_dat,
      phy = phy_sub,
      model = "lambda"
    )

    print(summary(mod))

    # Creating predictions predictions
    pred <- data.frame(
      bd_wmean = seq(
        min(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
        max(plot_dat$bd_wmean),
        length.out = 100
      ),
      hd_l = mean(plot_dat$hd_l)
    )

    pred$fit <- predict(
      mod,
      newdata = pred
    )

    # Plot data with ggplot2
    plots[[counter]] <- ggplot(
      plot_dat,
      aes(
        x = bd_wmean,
        y = .data[[trait]]
      )
    ) +

      geom_point(
        color = c(
          "Anomalopus" = "violet",
          "Glaphyromorphus" = "blue",
          "Hemiergis" = "skyblue",
          "Lerista" = "maroon"
        )[grp],
        size = 2
      ) +

      geom_line(
        data = pred,
        aes(
          x = bd_wmean,
          y = fit
        ),
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1
      ) +

      theme_classic() +

      labs(
        title = paste(grp, "-", trait),
        x = "Soil bulk density",
        y = c(
          fll = "Forelimb length",
          hll = "Hindlimb length",
          tll = "Total limb length"
        )[trait]
      )

    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

# Display plots
wrap_plots(plots)

#dev.off()

```

```{r}
  for(grp in groups) { # loop for each focal group 

    # Refining data set; filters species by focal group
    plot_dat <- df[
      df$focal_group == grp,
      c(
        "species",
        "focal_group",
        "bd_wmean",
        "hd_l",
        trait
      )
    ]

    plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat) # omits data when there is no value
    
     # Skip groups with fewer than five observations
    if(nrow(plot_dat) < 5) next # was causing problems

    # Match species to tree and removes species that are not present on the tree
    plot_dat <- plot_dat[
      plot_dat$species %in% tdat_disc$phy$tip.label,
    ]

    # Pruning tree
    phy_sub <- ape::keep.tip(
      tdat_disc$phy,

    # Arrange data so that it is the same order as the tree
    plot_dat <- plot_dat[
      match(phy_sub$tip.label, plot_dat$species),
    ]

    rownames(plot_dat) <- plot_dat$species

    n_species <- nrow(plot_dat) # recording the number of species in each group; was investigating warnings

    # Fit PGLS model
    mod <- phylolm(
      as.formula(
        paste(trait, "~ bd_wmean + hd_l") # "trait" refers to whichever trait is being analyzed either fll, hll, or tll
      ),
      data = plot_dat,
      phy = phy_sub,
      model = "lambda"
    )

    # Finding coefficients
    coef_tab <- summary(mod)$coefficients

    beta <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "Estimate"]
    p_value <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "p.value"]
    se <- coef_tab["bd_wmean", "StdErr"]

    # Finding R-squared: how much of observed is accounted for by predictors
    mod_summary <- summary(mod)

    r2 <- mod_summary$r.squared
    adj_r2 <- mod_summary$adj.r.squared # adjusted for predictors

    # Calculate 95% confidence intervals
    df_res <- n_species - length(coef(mod))
    tcrit <- qt(0.975, df_res)

    lower95 <- beta - tcrit * se
    upper95 <- beta + tcrit * se

    # Organize results
    results3 <- rbind(
      results3,
      data.frame(
        Trait = trait,
        Group = grp,
        N_species = n_species,
        Beta = beta,
        SE = se,
        P_value = p_value,
        R2 = r2,
        Adjusted_R2 = adj_r2,
        Lower95CI = lower95,
        Upper95CI = upper95
      )
    )
  }
}

print(results3)

# Note that this comes with a lot of warnings, I believe this is because of the low sample size for many of the groups. We ran this just to see if any significant patterns jumped out that would be worth investigating further. None did.
```

## FIT MODELS
Using relative limb length and PCA axis

```{r}

library(geiger)
library(ape)
library(dplyr)

# Relative limb traits

df$rel_fll <- df$fll / df$hd_l
df$rel_hll <- df$hll / df$hd_l
df$rel_tll <- df$tll / df$hd_l

traits <- c(
  "rel_fll",
  "rel_hll",
  "rel_tll",
  "MorphPC1"
)

phy <- tdat_disc$phy

model_results <- list()

for(trait in traits){

# Match species and tree

  trait_dat <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      species,
      all_of(trait)
    ) %>%
    na.omit()

  trait_vec <- trait_dat[[trait]]
  names(trait_vec) <- trait_dat$species

  td <- treedata(
    phy = phy,
    data = trait_vec,
    sort = TRUE
  )

  vec <- td$data[,1]
  names(vec) <- rownames(td$data)


# Fit models

  BM_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "BM")
  OU_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "OU")
  EB_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "EB")
  WN_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "white")
  Lambda_fit <- fitContinuous(td$phy,vec,model = "lambda")

  
  tmp <- data.frame(Trait = trait,Model = c("BM","OU","EB","White","Lambda"),

    logLik = c(
      BM_fit$opt$lnL,
      OU_fit$opt$lnL,
      EB_fit$opt$lnL,
      WN_fit$opt$lnL,
      Lambda_fit$opt$lnL
    ),

    AICc = c(
      BM_fit$opt$aicc,
      OU_fit$opt$aicc,
      EB_fit$opt$aicc,
      WN_fit$opt$aicc,
      Lambda_fit$opt$aicc
    )
  )
  
  tmp <- tmp %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_AICc = AICc - min(AICc),
    AkaikeWeight =
      exp(-0.5 * Delta_AICc) /
      sum(exp(-0.5 * Delta_AICc))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Delta_AICc)

  best_model <- tmp$Model[1]

  tmp$BestModel <- best_model

  model_results[[trait]] <- tmp
  
}


all_models <- do.call(
  rbind,
  model_results
)

all_models
```

# Parameter Uncertainty and Mo

del Comparison
Head length as covariate

```{r}
library(caper)

set.seed(123)
nsim <- 1000
traits <- c("fll", "hll", "tll")

uncertainty_results <- list()
comparison_results <- list()
simulation_results <- list()

# FUNCTIONS

# Simulate using the fitted mean and phylogenetic residual covariance
simulate_pgls <- function(mod) {
  mu <- drop(mod$x %*% coef(mod))
  sigma2 <- as.numeric(mod$RSSQ / mod$n)
  U <- chol(sigma2 * mod$Vt)
  y <- mu + drop(t(U) %*% rnorm(mod$n))
  names(y) <- rownames(mod$x)
  y
}

# Count regression coefficients, residual variance and estimated lambda
model_aicc <- function(mod) {
  k <- ncol(mod$x) + 1 + sum(mod$mlVals)
  n <- mod$n
  if (n <= k + 1) stop("Too few species to calculate AICc.")
  -2 * as.numeric(logLik(mod)) + 2 * k +
    2 * k * (k + 1) / (n - k - 1)
}

## FIT MODELS

for (trait in traits) {
  plot_dat <- df[, c("species", "bd_wmean", "hd_l", trait)]
  plot_dat <- na.omit(plot_dat)

# Centre predictors to help fit the quadratic model
  plot_dat$soil_c <- plot_dat$bd_wmean - mean(plot_dat$bd_wmean)
  plot_dat$head_c <- plot_dat$hd_l - mean(plot_dat$hd_l)

  comp_dat <- caper::comparative.data(
    phy = tdat_disc$phy, data = plot_dat,
    names.col = "species", vcv = TRUE
  )

  formulas <- list(
    Linear = as.formula(paste(trait, "~ soil_c + head_c")),
    Quadratic = as.formula(paste(trait, "~ soil_c + I(soil_c^2) + head_c"))
  )
  mods <- lapply(formulas, function(f) {
    caper::pgls(f, data = comp_dat, lambda = "ML", param.CI = NULL)
  })

# SIMULATE AND REFIT BOTH MODELS

  delta_aicc <- matrix(NA_real_, nsim, 2,
                      dimnames = list(NULL, names(mods)))

  for (generating in names(mods)) {
    mod <- mods[[generating]]
    estimates <- c(coef(mod), lambda = unname(mod$param["lambda"]))
    boot <- matrix(NA_real_, nsim, length(estimates),
                   dimnames = list(NULL, names(estimates)))

    for (i in seq_len(nsim)) {
      sim_y <- simulate_pgls(mod)
      sim_dat <- comp_dat
      sim_dat$data[[trait]] <- sim_y[rownames(sim_dat$data)]

      fits <- lapply(formulas, function(f) {
        tryCatch(
          caper::pgls(f, data = sim_dat, lambda = "ML", param.CI = NULL),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
      })

  # Parameter uncertainty uses refits of the generating model
      matched_fit <- fits[[generating]]
      if (!is.null(matched_fit)) {
        boot[i, ] <- c(coef(matched_fit),
                       lambda = unname(matched_fit$param["lambda"]))
      }

  # Model discrimination requires both fits to succeed
      if (any(vapply(fits, is.null, logical(1)))) next
      if (as.numeric(logLik(fits$Quadratic)) <
          as.numeric(logLik(fits$Linear)) - 1e-6) next

      # Positive values favour Quadratic; negative values favour Linear
      delta_aicc[i, generating] <-
        model_aicc(fits$Linear) - model_aicc(fits$Quadratic)
    }

  # ESTIMATE PARAMETER UNCERTAINTY

    ci <- apply(boot, 2, function(x) {
      x <- x[is.finite(x)]
      if (length(x) < 2) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
      quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975))
    })

    key <- paste(trait, generating, sep = "_")
    uncertainty_results[[key]] <- data.frame(
      Trait = trait, Model = generating, Parameter = names(estimates),
      Estimate = unname(estimates), Lower95 = ci[1, ], Upper95 = ci[2, ],
      Successful = colSums(is.finite(boot)), Attempted = nsim
    )
    simulation_results[[key]] <- boot
  }

  # ESTIMATE ABILITY TO DISTINGUISH MODELS

  linear_sim <- delta_aicc[, "Linear"]
  quad_sim <- delta_aicc[, "Quadratic"]
  linear_sim <- linear_sim[is.finite(linear_sim)]
  quad_sim <- quad_sim[is.finite(quad_sim)]
  if (!length(linear_sim) || !length(quad_sim)) {
    stop("No successful paired refits for ", trait)
  }

  comparison_results[[trait]] <- data.frame(
    Trait = trait,
    Observed_Delta_AICc = model_aicc(mods$Linear) - model_aicc(mods$Quadratic),
    False_positive = mean(linear_sim > 0),
    Power = mean(quad_sim > 0),
    False_negative = mean(quad_sim <= 0),
    Successful_linear = length(linear_sim),
    Successful_quadratic = length(quad_sim), Attempted_each = nsim
  )
  simulation_results[[paste0(trait, "_Delta_AICc")]] <- delta_aicc

  # PLOT MODEL SUPPORT

  breaks <- pretty(range(c(linear_sim, quad_sim)), n = 25)
  h1 <- hist(linear_sim, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  h2 <- hist(quad_sim, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  plot(h1, col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.5),
       ylim = c(0, max(h1$counts, h2$counts)), main = trait,
       xlab = "Delta AICc: Linear minus Quadratic")
  plot(h2, col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.5), add = TRUE)
  abline(v = 0, lty = 2)
  legend("topright", c("Simulated Linear", "Simulated Quadratic"),
         fill = c(rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.5), rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.5)), bty = "n")
}

# RESULTS

parameter_uncertainty <- do.call(rbind, uncertainty_results)
model_comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison_results)
print(parameter_uncertainty)
print(model_comparison)

```
